name: altitude
description: How high an entity has been: the score of a climbing game. The height is measured from where the entity started, only counts the best it reached (falling back loses nothing) and is turned into a whole score.

components.name: Altitude
components.description: Measures the highest the entity has been since its first tick: height is the distance between its starting y and its smallest y so far (y grows downwards, so higher means smaller), in world units, and score is height times scale as a whole number, rounded down. started and origin_y hold where it began.

systems.name: measure
systems.description: Updates the height and the score of every Altitude entity from its Position.
